fixes.where: index.html: every tree-full srcset + the <link rel=preload imagesrcset>
fixes.what: Add a middle candidate (export assets/tree/tree-full-1024.webp, ~260 KB) to every srcset and the preload: `tree-full-768.webp 768w, tree-full-1024.webp 1024w, tree-full.webp 1536w`.
fixes.why: At 390px × DPR 2 the sizes value 120vw needs 936 device px, so every real phone skips the 194 KB 768w file and downloads the 491 KB 1536w one; a 1024w step halves the heaviest phone asset.

fixes.what: Key the hidden state on a class canopy.js itself adds (`html.classList.add('canopy-ready')` at the top of the IIFE, after the `!main || !hasGsap` guard) and change the selector to `.canopy-ready.anim-ready .canopy .hero__rise{opacity:0}`.
fixes.why: site.js hides the logo and only canopy.js shows it: a 404, a CSP block or a syntax error in canopy.js leaves the hero logo at opacity 0 forever with GSAP otherwise running.

The parallaxed layer is the full page height × 120vw on phones (~2.5 MP, promoted by GSAP); Safari rasterises it whole, costing memory and jank on the audience's main device, for a 0.1× drift nobody reads at 390px.

fixes.what: Delete these rule groups from the canopy build (or move them to a legacy.css not loaded by index.html); site.js blocks 3 and the accordion/[data-track] code can stay since they no-op.
fixes.why: About 18 KB of the 54 KB stylesheet targets elements that exist on no page in this build; it is render-blocking CSS and a maintenance trap.

fixes.what: Drop `will-change:transform` from .tree__canopy (keep it on .tree__shake only) and let GSAP promote the canopy while its sway tween runs.
fixes.why: Two nested promoted layers of ~1440×1180 px each (≈14 MB of GPU texture) sit resident from first paint for a ±0.5° sway; one layer is enough and GSAP's force3D promotes the other on demand.

fixes.what: Gate the no-JS strip on `html:not(.js)` as well: `html:not(.js) .site-nav, html.js:not(.nav-ready) .site-nav{...}` is wrong direction; instead hide the links under `html.js:not(.nav-ready) .site-nav{visibility:hidden}` and keep the strip only for `html:not(.js)`.
fixes.why: On a slow phone the deferred vendor bundle (~130 KB) runs after first paint, so the full link strip flashes under the bar and then snaps into the drawer; the inline `js` class is set before paint and can suppress it.
